run_pipeline_kandinsky5_i2v: run the Kandinsky5I2VPipeline to generate a video from an input image and text prompt
encode_prompt_qwen: encode a text prompt using the Qwen2.5-VL text encoder to produce text embeddings and cumulative sequence lengths
encode_prompt_clip: encode a text prompt using the CLIP text encoder to produce pooled text embeddings
prepare_latents: prepare initial latent variables for image-to-video generation by encoding the input image as the first frame
normalize_first_frame: normalize the first few frames of video latents using adaptive mean and standard deviation matching
